contract: #41 (b): PvPService.CanAttack's kaiju exception (a Halo player may hit the Active kaiju in any zone, rookies allowed, protection ignored) does not apply while the attacker stands in a faction town (Config.Zones Town = true with a Faction: Halo Citadel, Horns Den); then the normal rules answer (a town is a safe zone, 'SafeZone'). The Crossroads (a town without a faction) and every zone outside the towns keep the exception; where the kaiju stands does not matter; a queued kaiju and Horns attackers never had the exception.
limitations: The zone comes from a ZoneService double (Config.Zones by id); the real ZoneService samples positions once a second. Client feedback for a blocked hit is unchanged (the same as any safe-zone hit).
